title: Baggage Section of the Travel Protection Plans Schedule
content:
Baggage cover under the Travel Protection Plans is carried in two parts: a benefit for baggage or an
article lost or damaged outright, held to an inner ceiling on any single article, and a benefit for checked
baggage that reaches the traveller late, payable from the plan's delay trigger onward. Both are limits for each
insured traveller.

| Plan | Baggage loss | Ceiling on any single article | Baggage delay | Delay trigger (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 750 | 250 | 200 | 24 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 1000 | 300 | 300 | 12 |
| TripGuard Plus | 1500 | 500 | 500 | 12 |
| TripGuard Premier | 2500 | 750 | 750 | 6 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 2500 | 750 | 750 | 6 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 1500 | 500 | 500 | 12 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 3500 | 1000 | 1000 | 6 |

Amounts are in USD.

## Worked against the inner ceiling

A single suitcase valued at 900 and lost outright reaches the article ceiling before it reaches the baggage
loss limit on every plan in the range: 250 on Trip Basics Essential, 300 on Trip Basics Standard, 500 on
TripGuard Plus and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, 750 on TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite, and
1000 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive, that last being the only plan of the seven whose article ceiling carries
the whole of a 900 article. The overall baggage loss limits behind those ceilings are 750, 1000, 1500, 2500,
2500, 1500 and 3500 in the order the plans stand in the table, and the value of 900 used here is an illustration
rather than a term of any plan.

Delay triggers stand at 24 hours on Trip Basics Essential, 12 hours on Trip Basics Standard, TripGuard Plus and
Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and 6 hours on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip
Executive; the delay benefits behind them are 200, 300, 500, 750, 750, 500 and 1000.
